title: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1996
PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1996
ACT III OF 1996
An Act further to amend the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 21st May, 1996]
No.Legis.2(1)/96/63, dated
21-5-1996.--The- Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the.
Punjab on the 12th day of May, 1996 and assented to by .the Governor of Punjab
on the 15th day of May, 1996, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Insertion of section 7-A in Act XLI of 1975

ACT III OF 1996
PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1996
ACT III OF 1996
An Act further to amend the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 21st May, 1996]
No.Legis.2(1)/96/63, dated
21-5-1996.--The- Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the.
Punjab on the 12th day of May, 1996 and assented to by .the Governor of Punjab
on the 15th day of May, 1996, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Insertion of section 7-A in Act XLI of 1975.--In the Punjab
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, after section 7, the
following shall be added:--
"7-A. Duty
free car.--The Chief Minister; during his tenure as such, may import or,
purchase out of bond one motor car with engine capacity upto 3200 cc car for
his personal use, without payment of custom duty and sales tax if exemption in
respect of the same is granted by the Federal Government. "
